title: Allow re-pairing already paired bluetooth devices in the pairing dialog
line: The Add Bluetooth Device wizard now lists already paired devices that are nearby and in pairing mode, and can pair them again.
explanation: The wizard's device list dropped every paired device, and its Next button refused paired devices, so a game controller that had since been paired to another computer could only be added back after removing it in System Settings. BlueZ also refuses to pair a device that is already paired (AlreadyExists). Now paired devices are listed when the current scan found them (they have a signal strength) and they are not connected; picking one removes the old pairing, waits for the still running scan to find the device again, then pairs it as usual.

commits.message:
wizard: allow pairing again devices that are already paired

The wizard hid every paired device, so a controller paired to another
computer had to be removed in the settings first. Paired devices found
by the scan are now listed, and picking one removes and re-pairs it.

BUG: 503988

media.caption: Master: the paired controller is nearby in pairing mode but missing from the list
Patched: the nearby paired controller is listed; out-of-range and connected paired devices stay hidden
Picking it and pressing Next removes the old pairing, pairs it again and connects; the wizard closes on success
